title: KAN and the hybrid 'Kerr layer (channel physics) + light KAN (residual clean-up)'
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit)
kerr_base: v3_one_hidden of E012: one hidden complex layer of 48 neurons with Kerr activation (AblationComplexMLP variant d), 6480 multiplies per symbol

kan.implementation: src/constellation_denoiser/kan.py, own efficient-KAN style layer: SiLU base path + B-spline path with learnable coefficients, spline order k = 3, grid G over [-2, 2] extended by k knots per side; no pykan / efficient-kan
kan.init: base weights Kaiming uniform, spline coefficients N(0, 0.1/sqrt(n*(G+k))); last KAN layer of hybrids initialized to zero so the hybrid starts equal to the Kerr MLP
kan.local_features: centre symbol and 3 neighbours on each side: 7 symbols, 14 real numbers [Re, Im]
kan.cost_convention: real multiplies: SiLU 1 per input; Cox-de Boor 4 per basis function and level; base linear m*n; spline linear m*n*(G+k) dense (as implemented) or m*n*(k+1) sparse (k+1 nonzero bases). Both written to runs: kan_macs_dense, kan_macs_sparse; macs_per_symbol = dense total, macs_per_symbol_merged = sparse total

k0_kerr.description: control: Kerr MLP alone, 40k steps from scratch

k0b_kerr_continued.description: Kerr MLP 20k steps, then 20k more with a fresh Adam: equal-steps control of the two-stage hybrids k3/k4 (with constant lr and no optimizer reset it would be identical to k0)

k1_kan_only.description: KAN [2W=62 -> 16 -> 2] on [Re, Im] of the whole window, 40k steps, MSE

k2_parallel_joint.description: out = Kerr(x) + KAN_res(local), KAN [14 -> 8 -> 2], joint training 40k steps

k3_parallel_staged.description: Kerr trained 20k steps then frozen; KAN_res [14 -> 8 -> 2] trained 20k steps on the residual (fresh Adam)

k4_cascade_staged.description: Kerr frozen after 20k steps; KAN input = [Kerr output (2), local (14)], KAN [16 -> 8 -> 2] predicts a correction, 20k steps

optimizer: Adam 1e-3 constant, batch 1024; complex MSE for Kerr-based models, MSE for k1

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.improves: a hybrid improves the Kerr base if its mean test reduction exceeds k0_kerr (for k2) or k0b_kerr_continued (for k3, k4) at the same total number of steps by more than the seed spread (range) and by at least 0.5 p.p.
rule_draft.cost: the added multiplies (dense and sparse, absolute and relative to k0_kerr) are reported next to the gain; 'worth it' is only concluded together with them
rule_draft.kerr_needed: comparison with k1_kan_only answers whether the Kerr base is needed at all
rule_draft.metric: test_reduction_valbest_select (test at the validation-best evaluation, every 1000 steps)

optional_residual_analysis: stage 'residual': error of the best k0_kerr (by validation) on the validation files versus the constellation point and the received-symbol amplitude
